title: Request drones on a mark or area
breadcrumb: Request drones on a mark or area

slides.title: Who answers your request
slides.html: Drones opens OpenDefence UAVOps, a separate plugin that this chapter uses to show how a request travels and how you follow it. You ask from OpenDefence Main, and those you ask answer in Drones.

slides.title: Tap the target button
slides.html: Tap the enemy mark, or the outline of an enemy or unknown area, then the target button, a crosshair in the ring of buttons around it. If ATAK first lists several items, tap the one you want.

slides.title: Read the sheet
slides.html: To first offers the unit HQ gave you a quota on, here 2R/1J, and the line below says how many requests you have left on it today. Send turns on once each choice has a pick.

slides.title: Pick and send
slides.html: Pick Strike or Recon, the priority, and under To your quota's unit, Any to ask every team, or HQ when it does not matter who flies. Tap Send.

slides.title: Follow it in the Inbox
slides.html: Tap Inbox. Your request shows under Sent with the time you sent it.

slides.title: Read the answer
slides.html: Open Inbox again to see the answer on the same row, here Declined: weather with a blue dot. Tap the row to fly to the target.

slides.title: Ask about an area
slides.html: You can also start from Drones, here for an area you drew with Markers on Unknown or Enemy, then Area. Tap Drones, then Ask for a drone beside My requests.

slides.title: Tap the area
slides.html: Tap the area's yellow outline, since a tap inside it does nothing. The phone's Back button cancels.

slides.title: Recon comes picked
slides.html: For an area Recon comes already picked. Pick who to ask and tap Send.
